## Required scientific parity checks

All three views and documentary records shall agree on:

- contract v0.2, document r0.3, scientific owner Grant Wilson, date
  2026-09-08, and status `Candidate for scientific-owner disposition`;
- the five-stage MAP lifecycle; separate product realization and
  `succeeded/failed/not_produced` attempt outcome; reached-prefix, failure,
  and empty-support rules;
- separation from PTC/VAL axes, ECS results, and ECS artifact realization;
- six independent current-candidate profile axes:
  `candidate/pending/pending/pending/unavailable/unavailable`, with historical
  exact approvals unchanged;
- all six exact roles, parent/membership invariants, and aggregate profile
  `SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2`;
- base-coadd retention of signal membership when response is unavailable or
  basis-incompatible, and role-qualified atomic rejection for selected named
  companions;
- exact response-family-qualified `R_coadd,out^(R) = B_out T_obs^(R)` only for
  same-family compatible members, fixed coadd state, and an exact composition
  theorem; coadd-procedure and whole-chain responses separately unavailable;
- exact `SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE` prerequisites and prohibition of
  implicit fill/intersection/association/interpolation/reprojection/gauge;
- restricted NOI ownership/claim terminology;
- exact result and evidence-artifact vocabularies;
- PTC product identity without an undefined MAP-local `q`, `K_p` only as
  response accumulator, `bold Sigma^obs` as stacked covariance, `Pi` as plan,
  and `J_out` as row selector;
- typed above-one cut override, five cut stages, pre-application resolved
  value, applied-event binding, inclusivity, invalid behavior, no default, and
  small-N order statistic, including exact `Q_star=0` for `N=0` without a
  selected element or zero-sky meaning; owner-directed no-support outcome
  `not_produced` with no empty bundle; and
- exact finite WCS center/boundary/corner population, frame/generation,
  great-circle metric, binary64 precision, fail-on-invalid rule, and bounded
  claim; and
- the exact document-role hierarchy: shared core sole normative source,
  formal PDF canonical rendered normative view, rationale explanatory, and
  ECS prospective procedure.

## Cover and transitive-input check

Each view shall include its exact `identity/*.tex` fragment on the physical
cover after the title. Cover values bind shared and entry bytes separately,
avoiding self-digest cycles. A final verifier shall resolve every transitive
input, reproduce every raw and aggregate digest, and confirm that the
rationale/ECS add no independent science.

Any scientific mismatch is a candidate-source defect requiring corrected
bytes, new hashes, clean rebuild, and renewed review. A successful structural
or PDF check alone cannot establish scientific acceptance or implementation
conformance.
